title: More On Java
description: This Minecraft Java Neoforge adds different ores and biomes.
body: This is More On Java Minecraft Java Neoforge Mod in which many things are there. There is an item called steel crafted with iron and coal. Hammer crafted with 6 steel and 1 stick. Ores like Purple Ore, Bluelite Ore and Aluminium Ore. A new tool is there called Multool which can be used as axe and pickaxe. It can be crafted with netherite, purpie and steel. Biomes like Purple Biome, Blueness Biome, Yellwon Biome, Great Oaks Biome and the Bluken Biome. A food item is also added called Bun. It is crafted with 3 wheat and 3 seeds. 2 Flowers called Purple Flower and Min Flower are also added. More updates will come soon adding more things.
